Description: Founded with a dedication to excellence and diversity, Berkeley Ballet Theater is a groundbreaking non-profit institution, providing professional-level ballet training to dancers of any age, race, gender, or socio-economic class, with the goal of breaking down the narrow, monochromatic aesthetic traditional to ballet. BBT supports and integrates our mission of diversity and excellence into every core program. Our Children’s Division provides a graduated syllabus for young dancers ages 2.5-21 to support physical and artistic development culminating in a pre-professional Youth Company; the Adult Division offers more than 35 adult ballet classes weekly including 14 with live musical accompaniment. To promote gender diversity in a historically female- dominated art form, BBT provides a Boys' Fellowship program for males ages 7-19 to receive financial support, specialized classes, and mentorship. This summer, 100% of our senior Fellowship dancers have been accepted to (and are attending) elite training intensives with San Francisco Ballet, Pacific Northwest Ballet, and American Ballet Theater. Extensive childhood development research demonstrates that participation in dance can help youth become better equipped for adulthood: physiologically by increasing range of motion, coordination and endurance; psychologically by expressing emotions through movement; socially by navigating group dynamics through non-verbal communication; and cognitively in which the mind problem-solves with the body to achieve desired outcomes. Hundreds of studies have concluded that dance can teach children to better function in the world. For 35 years, Berkeley Ballet Theater has maintained a nationally renowned faculty which provides the highest levels of artistic training in an inclusive and nurturing environment, creating a legacy of dancers who have gone on to professional careers at the highest level of the art form as well as others who have maintained a lifelong love and appreciation for ballet. Where other companies pursue excellence at the expense of diversity, or pursue diversity at the expense of excellence, BBT embodies the belief that diversity and excellence go hand in hand.
